label: Custom Provider
description: Serve LLM calls on any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (a self-hosted vLLM or Ollama, an enterprise gateway, a niche vendor): base URL, model, and optionally a pasted API key. Wire the provider output into any LLM node.

steps: Paste the endpoint's API key below and name the connection.
The endpoint's address lives on the Custom Provider node itself, not here.

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Connection
inputs.description: Optional: the endpoint's API key, sent as a Bearer header. Leave unpicked for an endpoint that takes bare calls.

inputs.name: baseUrl
inputs.label: Base URL
inputs.description: The endpoint's base address; the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions path is derived from it.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Name
inputs.description: A display name for this endpoint, used in error messages.

outputs.name: provider
outputs.description: The provider value: wire it into an LLM node's provider input.

then.message: CustomProvider '{id}' has no base URL; set the endpoint's address on the node.
CustomProvider '{id}' has no model; name one on the node.
